result:
If I could change one thing, I’d make **power accountable to the people it affects**. Exploiting or harming someone shouldn’t be something you can profit from while walking away untouched.

I’d change the incentives, not just ask people to be kinder. I think a lot of cruelty is easier when the consequences land somewhere else.

What’s your one?
